Now, suppose x is not in the nullspace of A. Then, Ax ≠ 0, which means that the dot product of x with each row of A is not 0. Conversely, suppose x is in the row space of AT. Then, x can be written as a linear combination of the rows of AT. Since the row space of AT is orthogonal to the nullspace of AT, x is also orthogonal to the nullspace of AT.
